metadata.why_justification: The prompt asks for the reason each account escalates. ACC-07, ACC-08 escalate on the first limb — their own flagged share is strictly above the batch figure — and the memo has to say so next to each of them.

metadata.how_justification: Opens composite_request_memo.md with md.extract_text and applies regex_match.
metadata.why_justification: ACC-02, ACC-03 escalates only on the second limb — a single request carrying three or more findings — and its share is below the batch figure, so naming it without that reason is the wrong reason.

metadata.how_justification: Opens composite_request_memo.md with md.extract_text and applies regex_match.
metadata.why_justification: sit exactly on the batch figure. §8 escalates only on a share strictly greater than it, so these stay with the intake desk; the prompt asks the memo to say which accounts sat on the figure and why that leaves them.

metadata.how_justification: Opens composite_request_memo.md with md.extract_text and applies regex_match.
metadata.why_justification: The prompt asks for the record that decides each finding. For REQ-05, REQ-09, REQ-10, REQ-17, REQ-21, REQ-27, REQ-28, REQ-30 that record is a specific licence id — including the superseding row where the chain moves the terms — and it has to be named against the request it decides.

metadata.how_justification: Opens composite_request_memo.md with md.extract_text and applies regex_match.
metadata.why_justification: COMMERCIAL_DISTRIBUTION_FLAG is decided by the account's master agreement, not by anything on the request row, so the memo has to point at the agreement next to each of REQ-02, REQ-14, REQ-20, REQ-23, REQ-27, REQ-30.

metadata.how_justification: Opens composite_request_memo.md with md.extract_text and applies regex_match.
metadata.why_justification: MISSING_MINOR_CONSENT is decided by the consent record — its type, or its expiry against the audit date — and the memo has to name it against REQ-05, REQ-14, REQ-32.

metadata.how_justification: Opens composite_request_memo.md with md.extract_text and applies regex_match.
metadata.why_justification: The prompt asks which requests the personal-use allowance clears. REQ-01, REQ-22, REQ-32 are cleared under §3 by it; REQ-32 is cleared under §3 and still carries a finding the allowance does not reach, which is the scope §3 spells out.

assertion.expected: (?is)^(?=[\s\S]*(?:\bREQ-01\b[\s\S]{0,600}?(?:allowance|personal[\s_-]?(?:use|only))|(?:allowance|personal[\s_-]?(?:use|only))[\s\S]{0,600}?\bREQ-01\b))(?=[\s\S]*(?:\bREQ-22\b[\s\S]{0,600}?(?:allowance|personal[\s_-]?(?:use|only))|(?:allowance|personal[\s_-]?(?:use|only))[\s\S]{0,600}?\bREQ-22\b))(?=[\s\S]*(?:\bREQ-32\b[\s\S]{0,600}?(?:allowance|personal[\s_-]?(?:use|only))|(?:allowance|personal[\s_-]?(?:use|only))[\s\S]{0,600}?\bREQ-32\b))(?=[\s\S]*(?:\bREQ-32\b[\s\S]{0,600}?(?:still|but|nonetheless|however|does not (?:clear|reach|release|pardon)|only releases|§\s*3 only|not a general)|(?:still|but|nonetheless|however|does not (?:clear|reach|release|pardon)|only releases|§\s*3 only|not a general)[\s\S]{0,600}?\bREQ-32\b))

metadata.how_justification: Opens composite_request_memo.md with md.extract_text and applies regex_match.
metadata.why_justification: The prompt asks what the lapsed agreements change. ACC-04, ACC-08 are lapsed, and under §6 that is what stops their public or paid requests being cleared.

assertion.expected: (?is)^(?=[\s\S]*(?:\bACC-04\b[\s\S]{0,600}?(?:laps\w*)|(?:laps\w*)[\s\S]{0,600}?\bACC-04\b))(?=[\s\S]*(?:\bACC-08\b[\s\S]{0,600}?(?:laps\w*)|(?:laps\w*)[\s\S]{0,600}?\bACC-08\b))(?=[\s\S]*(?:\bACC-04\b[\s\S]{0,600}?(?:COMMERCIAL_DISTRIBUTION_FLAG|routing|public|paid|for sale|cannot be cleared|no longer)|(?:COMMERCIAL_DISTRIBUTION_FLAG|routing|public|paid|for sale|cannot be cleared|no longer)[\s\S]{0,600}?\bACC-04\b))(?=[\s\S]*(?:\bACC-08\b[\s\S]{0,600}?(?:COMMERCIAL_DISTRIBUTION_FLAG|routing|public|paid|for sale|cannot be cleared|no longer)|(?:COMMERCIAL_DISTRIBUTION_FLAG|routing|public|paid|for sale|cannot be cleared|no longer)[\s\S]{0,600}?\bACC-08\b))
